results.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
results.overview: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

results.title: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief
results.original_title: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief
results.overview: Accident prone teenager, Percy discovers he's actually a demi-God, the son of Poseidon, and he is needed when Zeus' lightning is stolen. Percy must master his new found skills in order to prevent a war between the Gods that could devastate the entire world.

results.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
results.overview: In their quest to confront the ultimate evil, Percy and his friends battle swarms of mythical creatures to find the mythical Golden Fleece and to stop an ancient evil from rising.

results.title: The Lightning Thief: The Percy Jackson Musical
results.original_title: The Lightning Thief: The Percy Jackson Musical
results.overview: Based on the first book in Rick Riordan's series, the story follows 12-year-old Percy Jackson, who discovers he is a demigod with newly emerging powers and a target for mythological monsters. Accused of stealing Zeus's master lightning bolt, Percy embarks on a quest across modern-day America to find the true thief, prevent a war among the gods, and reach the Underworld.

results.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians Official Podcast
results.original_name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians Official Podcast
results.overview: Hosted by Aryan Simhadri, it features behind-the-scenes stories, cast and crew interviews (including Rick Riordan), and fun insights that celebrate the world and fandom of Percy Jackson.

results.title: On The Red Carpet Presents: "Percy Jackson"
results.original_title: On The Red Carpet Presents: "Percy Jackson"
results.overview: From San Diego Comic Con to on board Disney Cruise Line's Destiny, we're with the cast of the Emmy-winning Disney+ Original series "Percy Jackson and the Olympians" for a behind the scenes look at the popular fantasy series.

results.title: A Hero's Journey: The Making of Percy Jackson and the Olympians
results.original_title: A Hero's Journey: The Making of Percy Jackson and the Olympians
results.overview: Alongside a passionate cast and crew, follow Walker Scobell, Leah Sava Jeffries and Aryan Simhadri as they step into worlds fit for gods, battle unforgettable creatures, and perform legendary stunts.
